description: For repositories where a person merges the non-major branch: digests, digest pins and CI action updates carry no code a person would review, so they share a branch of their own that opens without a tick and merges itself once its checks are green.

packageRules.description: Docker and CI action digests and digest pins. A digest moves a tag that is already pinned to the same version, so the soak does not apply.
CI action updates change only how CI runs. Taken out of the person-merged branch, because Renovate merges a group only when every update in it merges itself; they keep the soak of their update type.
